in_marathi.name: Saanidh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saanidh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saanidh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'saanidhana', which means 'wise', 'intelligent'. The name is believed to bring wisdom and intelligence to the one who bears it.
